sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The detail window (the one a link preview opens) can be made bigger on a phone. Its resize corner is the browser's own, and that answers a mouse only, so on a phone the window kept its size. A new ⤢ beside ✕ makes it fill what the screen shows, following when you zoom or pan; ⤡ gives it its size back, and the next window opens the way you left it. On a desktop a double-click on an empty part of its title bar does the same. On a touch screen a grip in the lower-right corner resizes it with a finger.

sections.label: 🐛 Fix
items: On a phone you can stop a fetch again. A narrow screen moves the fetch buttons into the ☰ SAED menu as its "Load" rows, and that also hid the button that turns into "■ Stop · n / N" while pages load, so a long paginated fetch could not be stopped. Now, while a fetch runs, that button comes back beside ☰ SAED with its progress, "Stopping…" and "Rendering…", and the bar is one line again when it is done. In the menu, the running row says Stop as well, and the other Load rows wait the way their buttons do.
